results.title: Trump at South Florida rally revives the idea of military intervention in Cuba after Iran
results.description: President Donald Trump says U.S. warships returning from Iran could stop in Cuba. It's his latest suggestion of taking an interventionist approach to the nearby country. This idea, mentioned during a rally in South Florida on Friday, is part of…

results.title: Kenosha cancels October 26 parks commission meeting due to lack of agenda items
results.description: The Kenosha Board of Parks Commission meeting set for October 26 has been cancelled because there were no agenda items to discuss.
